name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog and an approved Awin Feed, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.8.3 exposes one product-search entrypoint across configured product sources plus an authorized bounded Chrome fallback. Commercial relationships never affect relevance or ranking. Every card has an explicit ZIP-quote capability and a stable selectionId for follow-up inspection, delivered-total quotes, and Watch rules. Street addresses are never requested or persisted in chat; unsupported ZIP quotes recover to merchant checkout or another existing card. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Search products, find verified deals, or create and bind a Watch to Codex Automation. Never launch MCP.
